::: {.sheet-actions}
Six songs on one sheet of paper, printed front and back.

<div class="form-check form-switch">
<input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" role="switch" id="chords-switch" checked>
<label class="form-check-label" for="chords-switch">Chords</label>
</div>

<a class="btn btn-primary" href="sanctuary-boston-2026-10-retreat.pdf" download><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> PDF with chords</a>
<a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="sanctuary-boston-2026-10-retreat-lyrics.pdf" download><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> PDF, lyrics only</a>
<button class="btn btn-outline-secondary" type="button" onclick="window.print()"><i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Print</button>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Chords switch. ?chords=off starts with it off (used to make the lyrics-only PDF).
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const box = document.getElementById("chords-switch");
  const book = document.querySelector(".songbook");
  const apply = () => book.classList.toggle("no-chords", !box.checked);
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("chords") === "off") box.checked = false;
  box.addEventListener("change", apply);
  apply();
});
</script>
```
